blocks.title: Tree
blocks.text: Tree maloomat ko aik markazi nuqte, root node, se phailta hua munazzam karta hai. Har node doosre nodes se jur sakta hai, aur shaakhdar banawat banti hai, list ke bar-aks jo seedhi line mein hoti hai.

Family tree mein sab se purane buzurg jarr hain, aur har shakhs ki aulad agle levels banati hai. Aise walidain-aulad ke rishte seedhi list mein rakhna mushkil hai, is liye tree istemal hota hai. Kitab ke mutabiq tree data structures pehli baar computer scientist John McCarthy ne 1960 mein pesh kiye (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Family tree list ki bajaye tree mein kyun behtar rakha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: List sirf ek seedhi tarteeb rakhti hai, jabke tree yeh rakhta hai ke kaun kis ka walid hai, yaani shaakhdar darja-bandi.

items: Tree: jarr se phailte nodes; family tree jaisi darja-bandi ke liye munasib.
